# telegram-approvals

> Human approval queue for agent actions with HMAC-signed Telegram inline buttons, approver allow list, expiry and a bounded audit trail Python package `trysac-telegram-approvals`, import name `telegram_approvals`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
